@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 的功能「实时用量记录」：监听请求事件，将模型调用信息追加到按日 JSONL 日志并以请求 ID 去重。
@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 的功能「首次启动历史回填」：安装后遍历已持久化会话日志，补录先前请求并跳过已记录项目。
@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 的功能「用量统计仪表盘」：在 Web 设置页提供筛选、汇总、趋势和明细统计，可按日期和模型查看。
@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 的功能「当前提供方配额」：输入栏按钮展示当前模型提供方配额窗口或余额，并支持错误重试。
@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 的功能「在线价格与费用」：从配置的国内或海外价格源同步模型价格，为用量记录计算费用。

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage 是面向 DSH Web 的用量统计插件。它监听模型请求并将 Token、模型、会话和时间等记录保存在本地，同时首次启动时回填历史会话。插件提供设置页和侧边栏仪表盘，可按日期、模型、项目、会话或提供方查看用量、趋势与费用，并在输入栏显示支持提供方的配额。还包含会话用量视图、价格表和数据目录迁移。无需单独配置插件密钥，配额查询使用 DSH 已配置的提供方凭据。

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage tracks DSH Web model usage in local logs and backfills session history. Its dashboard shows filtered token use, trends and costs; a session view and provider quota button are included. Pricing syncs from a regional feed, and quota checks use DSH provider credentials.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · dsh-token-usage：A dsh usage plugin that displays model token usage right in the Web UI. The sidebar's **Token Usage** entry opens a full-width dashboard — summary cards (with cost), a trend chart, and five detail boards (projects / sessions, models / providers, runtime overhead); the same statistics live in **Settings → Token Usage** behind five detail tabs (by project / by model / by session / by provider / runtime overhead). Both surfaces share date-range and model filters; a single-day range uses an hourly trend and wider ranges use daily points.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · dsh-token-usage：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **GitHub direct installs have ended** — the repository no longer carries prebuilt output. Install from npm instead:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add @laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage
> ```
>
> **Upgrading from a legacy `github:` install (≤ 0.3.7, package name `dsh-token-usage`)?** An in-place `update` fails to load — remove the old name first, then add again. Usage data under `$DSH_HOME/token-usage/` carries over untouched.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Features：- **Live recording**: every provider-billed model call is recorded as it happens — tokens, cost, model, session — conversation requests, context-compaction calls, and auxiliary system calls included: the Auto review authorization reviewer, session-title generation, and reasoning translation. Auxiliary calls bill into the totals and the model breakdown. The ones the host proves belong to a session (session-title generation) also join that session's totals, trend and request pool, tagged with their kind; the rest stay global and are broken out by kind in the **Runtime overhead** board. That history cannot be backfilled — the host keeps no usage record of those calls, and recording starts with the first request after upgrading.
- **Web stats page**: filters (date range + model + `1d`/`7d`/`30d` shortcuts), eight compact summary cards in two rows, and a trend chart (hourly for one day, daily for wider ranges; hover a point for its total). The request card carries **failed** and **overhead** pills. The detail block is a five-tab switcher — **projects / models / sessions / providers / runtime overhead** — sharing the dashboard's row layout:

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Features：- **Main-column dashboard**: the sidebar's **Token Usage** entry opens the same metrics as a five-board dashboard (projects / sessions, models / providers, runtime overhead). The boards collapse to one column when the available content width is narrow; **Pin to sidebar** on this plugin's **configuration card** in the host's **Plugins** page moves the entry out of the **More** menu into a resident sidebar row (switch it off to move it back) — the two never coexist.
- **Provider usage dimension**: the settings panel gains a **By provider** tab and the dashboard a **Providers** card, listing each provider route key's usage — display name · relative bar · total tokens · cache hit rate · billed cost (cost comes from the same rates as the by-model view and reprices when the price table updates). The sort switches between total tokens and cost, and each of the two entries remembers its own sort choice (changing it in the settings panel leaves the dashboard untouched). Usage without a route key is never folded into a named provider: it stays a single **Missing provider** remainder row, sorted last and dimmed (a question mark beside the name ex

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Features：- **Cost figures & model pricing**: per-request cost is computed live from per-model rates (¥ per million tokens); unpriced models warn and count as ¥0. Click a priced model name in the dashboard to open its full price table; holding Ctrl while clicking a priced model filters the view to that model. The filter row carries a **pricing table** entry opening an overview of every model in the cloud feed — searchable, with simulated billing and expandable effective rates; the **Model alias associations** button next to the dialog title opens a separate dialog that manages the local alias→model associations and lets you revoke them. Rates sync from the cloud feed on every startup — see [Model pricing](#model-pricing).

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Features：- **Provider quota**: an input-bar button (left of the model chip) shows the selected provider's remaining quota. See [Provider quota](#provider-quota).
- **History backfill**: the first startup syncs requests that happened before installation (idempotent); unreadable session logs are skipped and counted, never fatal to the sync.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Model pricing：Costs are billed per record at its own timestamp. Identification or pricing-rule changes reselect historical rates from raw records on the next read. Models resolve through full original ID matching, provider-prefix ID matching, then upstream aliasPatterns (deprecated aliases are ignored), all ignoring case while preserving versions and model variants. Unknown or ambiguous names have no inferred price. The single source is a cloud mirror auto-synced on every startup — pricing corrections belong upstream in the [model-price-table](https://github.com/LaoYueHanNi/model-price-table) feed, so every user benefits at once. A hand-edited `pricing.json` is no longer read; if you maintain one it is silently ignored after upgrading (the file is left on disk). Upgrading from 0.4.1 or earlier to 0.4.2 triggers a one-time full rebuild of the usage rollup the first time the stats page is read — the larger the history, the longer it takes; this is expected. An invalid new feed keeps the previous valid mirror. If pricing is unavailable or history cannot be fully repriced, available usage remains visible while unreliable costs are hidden with a rea

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Data directory：Editable on this plugin's **configuration card** in the host's **Plugins** page: saving an absolute path takes effect immediately — history migrates automatically, no restart, no manual move. Blank keeps the default `~/.dsh/token-usage/`. A save is refused while a conversation is in progress; wait for it to end, then save again. Or set it directly:

```yml
plugins:
  token-usage:
    path: D:/data/token-usage   # default: ~/.dsh/token-usage/
```

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Pricing region：The pricing mirror follows your region: **Gitee** by default (fast inside mainland China) or the **GitHub mirror** of the same table — pick once on the **Pricing region** dropdown of that configuration card in the host's Plugins page, or via config. The pick also drives the display currency (¥ RMB vs $ USD at the table's exchange rate).

```yml
plugins:
  token-usage:
    pricingRegion: overseas   # default: domestic
```

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Provider quota：Unsupported providers hide the button; a failed query can be retried from the panel. On by default; turn it off with `quota.enabled: false`. Not supported yet: Volcengine, ZenMux, Zhipu Team plan, Claude / Codex / Gemini / Grok official subscriptions, GitHub Copilot.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Provider quota：A magpie route needs no setup: declare any OpenAI-compatible provider whose base URL points at the gateway (`http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1` by default) — the plugin probes the gateway's hello and reads its aggregated quota report. The gateway key goes in the provider's API key when the gateway is shared from another machine; a loopback gateway needs none.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Provider quota：Magpie cards follow the selected model immediately, before sending a request. Reads always use `?kept=1`: polling, opening the panel and retrying only read Magpie's own cache, never trigger upstream quota refreshes. Refresh quotas in Magpie when newer readings are needed; an empty cache does not fall back to a live vendor query.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Provider quota：Several keys and accounts of one vendor back each other up inside the gateway: the input-bar ring shows that vendor pool's **mean level** and colors it by the pool's availability (one spent account turns it yellow, only a fully spent pool turns it red), while the panel still lists every account's own share. Routing groups (no determinable request model) keep one level per vendor.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Install：Requires dsh `0.2.1-rc.3` or newer.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage
```

> The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `add` wires the plugin into the profile automatically — installs work out of the box, and the first startup backfills pre-install history.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage
```

Data files under `$DSH_HOME/token-usage/` are kept — delete them manually if you no longer need them.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Development：Build once, install a symlink, iterate:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build:all
pnpm test                # vitest
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:/plugins/dsh-token-usage

Rebuild and restart `dsh web` to apply changes (`pnpm watch:client` in the plugin directory hot-reloads the client). No `prepare` script by design — `lib/` never enters the repo; `pnpm publish` builds it fresh into the tarball.

@laoyuehanni/dsh-token-usage README · Development：Temporary host-only mount (this launch only, no profile changes): copy `cordis.example.yml` to `cordis.yml`, point `name` at the absolute `file://` URL of your `lib/index.js`, then `dsh web --patch <plugin-dir>/cordis.yml`. Data recording works in this mode; for UI work use the `link:` install above.
